items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: me and Ryan joke about that too because you don’t really have to be in tune because we like play it so fast that it sounds in tune

ctx.x: Well I’ve noticed that some of the melodies I’ve heard you play are like staccato with a capital S [scats]. You know they’re very —

Yeah. Short. That’s what — me and Ryan joke about that too because you don’t really have to be in tune because we like play it so fast that it sounds in tune. Like [brief horn] ah the reed’s all dry, but you have to slow it down to really hear, was that in tune? But yeah. A lot of it is very percussive situations and fast.
Do you ever growl into your horn.
